d: We’re looking for an Associate Operations to join the talabat tMart team and own the end-to-end running of our dark store operations, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and delivered accurately and on time to delight our customers.
Execute the daily operations of the tMart dark store, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and an outstanding customer experience from order placement to doorstep delivery.
Monitor and manage store inventory by conducting regular stock counts, flagging low-stock items, and coordinating replenishment to prevent out-of-stock situations.
Receive and organize incoming stock by verifying deliveries against purchase orders, ensuring correct storage conditions, and maintaining a clean and organized store layout.
Identify and escalate operational issues, system errors, or delivery exceptions promptly to minimize disruption and maintain order fulfillment targets.
Collaborate with riders, the operations team, and cross-functional partners to ensure smooth last-mile delivery and continuously improve store performance.
q: Proven experience in an operations, fulfillment, or retail role, ideally within a q-commerce, e-commerce, or fast-paced logistics environment. Strong understanding of order management and store operations.
Prior experience in a dark store, warehouse, or last-mile delivery operation is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with inventory management systems or WMS tools; ability to quickly learn new operational platforms and tools.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment while maintaining high accuracy in order picking and stock handling.
Understanding of q-commerce or retail operations metrics such as pick rate, order accuracy, stock availability, and on-time dispatch.
Understanding of operations management principles including workflow coordination, shift planning, and continuous process improvement.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in order fulfillment, stock management, and shift reporting.
Excellent problem-solving skills to identify and resolve operational issues quickly, keeping customer experience at the forefront.
Good communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Make appropriate decisions, work independently, and communicate clearly and effectively.
Fluent in English (written and spoken) is required. Knowledge of Arabic is a plus.
x: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

d: As an Institutional Client Service Relationship Manager at Fisher Investments Arabia, you will have the essential responsibility to ensure we are servicing our clients. Reporting to the GVP of Client Service, within the first year you will become very familiar with Fisher's investment philosophy and how it is implemented across numerous strategies.
q: At least 5 years' experience managing relationships of institutional clients within the wealth/asset management industry
Fluency in English is a must, also fluency in Arabic required
Committed to maintain quality of work while sticking to self-imposed timelines
Engage with a wide array of audiences by phone, email and in person and also values collaboration
Desire to enhance and maintain a deep knowledge of financial markets, ESG, Fisher's investment philosophy and institutional investment strategies

The global Fisher organisation distinguishes itself by always putting our clients first, providing them with unmatched service, and taking a personalised investing approach. This unique model has helped the global Fisher organization grow to serve over 150,000 clients globally, who entrust us with over $236 billion (USD) in assets under management.

Our employees make our purpose possible, and to help our employees meet their long-term goals, we offer an array of benefits. We take great pride in our inclusive culture. We value the different perspectives and unique skills you bring to the team – it makes us all better. Success at Fisher is motivated by results, a collaborative mindset and a commitment to accomplishing great things – so if you are ready to do that, we are ready for you! Apply today to be a part of a team environment where you make a difference in the lives of people by bettering the investment universe.
FISHER INVESTMENTS SAUDI ARABIA IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
r: Lead portfolio reviews for clients and related partners
Educate clients on Fisher investment philosophy, portfolio strategies, and market outlook
Become the expert on your assigned clients and their investment goals
Work with the Institutional ESG team to facilitate client co-engagement opportunities and lead ESG projects
Anticipate and fulfil client requests, identify opportunities and threats for each client
Identify cross-sell and addition opportunities for Sales Relationship Managers
Create customised action plans for each client to further build relationships and minimise risks

d: Atkins are searching for a Senior Project Manager to join our team with experience of managing large-scale multi-disciplinary projects within KSA and the GCC Region. The candidate is to have a minimum of 15+ years experience within the Middle East.

The selected candidate will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects within the KSA and GCC Region. They will be responsible for leading and managing projects within the business. Their primary role is to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet client requirements.

The selected candidate will work with the AtkinsRealis team and Client to establish project objectives, develop project plans, manage project budgets, and oversee project scheduling. They will be responsible for managing the project team, ensuring that team members are completing tasks on time and communication is maintained at all times.

Other roles also include managing project risk, developing contingency plans and ensuring that health and safety standards are followed in addition to adherence of AtkinsRealis' project management methodology requirements.
Communicate scope, fee, deliverables and programme with the team through Project Kick-Offs and regular updates.
Management of sub-consultants' agreements and payments (technical management through Design Management function).
Ensure that the Project Execution Plan addresses design management requirements, including integration and interface management between Client requirements, sub-consultant design packages.
Support the PD and PM in production of the Project Management suite of documents and standard forms.
Assist in risk identification and management.
Assist PD and PM to identify and manage scope changes, scope extensions.
Identify resourcing issues and requirements and coordinate these with the Technical Team Leads.
Escalate to PD / PM when/if required.
Provide timely external and internal monthly reporting by implementing a planned delivery schedule for routine reporting.
Ensure Quality Systems processes are adhered to in the delivery of projects.
Assisting in managing the work financially, technically and contractually.
Monitor Design Team progress and costs – Highlight where costs are not tracking as planned and coordinate with the Project Technical Leads to mitigate against potential over-runs / underspends.
Have a good understanding of Risk and the need to use their commercial acumen.
Manage Risks proactively through use of the tools provided and regular team and Client engagement and update Contingency requirements regularly (min. once per design stage).
Prepare Invoices for review and sign-off by the Project Director and keep financial registers up to date.
Liaise and interact with the client for the technical delivery components of the project.
q: Minimum of 20 years' experience within the Middle East.
Schedule management (schedule reviews, schedule various analysis).
Cost management (cost estimate, cost control and cost forecasting).
Contracts Management (Saudi Government procurement law and its executive bylaw).
PMI Standards of project management as earn value management and change control.
Development and enhancement of NO processes/ procedures.
